queries.name: blast_radius
topology_at
queries.cypher:
// purpose: The dependency graph as it was at $at: every DEPENDS_ON edge live at that time. FalkorDB's algorithms walk every edge of a graph and the tenant graph keeps retired and not-yet-live dependencies as history, so this is what gets projected into a scratch graph for an algorithm to run on.
MATCH (a:Service)-[r:DEPENDS_ON]->(b:Service)
WHERE r.valid_from <= $at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > $at)
RETURN a.id AS caller, b.id AS callee
ORDER BY caller, callee

queries.name: project_topology
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Build the point-in-time projection: runs on the scratch graph scratch_<tenant>_topology_<nonce>, which then holds only the edges live at the time in question.
UNWIND $edges AS e
MERGE (a:Service {id: e.caller})
MERGE (b:Service {id: e.callee})
MERGE (a)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(b)
RETURN count(*) AS edges

queries.name: criticality
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Criticality of every service: PageRank over the dependency graph (a service is critical when services that many others rely on rely on it). Runs on the scratch projection, so a retired or not-yet-live dependency never adds rank.
CALL algo.pageRank('Service', 'DEPENDS_ON') YIELD node, score
RETURN node.id AS service, score
ORDER BY score DESC, service

queries.name: recall_similar
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Episodic recall by structure, not text: resolved incidents whose root-cause service is on the alerting service's live dependency path. Same symptom scores higher.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(o:Service)
MATCH (past:Incident {status: 'resolved'})-[:CAUSED_BY]->(c:Change)-[:CHANGED]->(s:Service)
WHERE past.opened_at < a.at AND past.id <> i.id
WITH o, s, a.at AS alert_at, a, past, c
CALL {
  // Live hops o -> s (same block as path_suspects, which explains it).
  WITH o, s, alert_at
  WITH o, s, alert_at, shortestPath((o)-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(s)) AS sp
  WHERE sp IS NOT NULL
  WITH o, s, alert_at, sp,
       all(r IN relationships(sp) WHERE r.valid_from <= alert_at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > alert_at)) AS live
  OPTIONAL MATCH p = (o)-[e:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(s)
  WHERE NOT live AND e.valid_from <= alert_at AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to > alert_at)
  WITH live, sp, min(length(p)) AS shortest_live
  WITH CASE WHEN live THEN length(sp) ELSE shortest_live END AS hops
  WHERE hops IS NOT NULL
  RETURN hops
}
OPTIONAL MATCH (past)-[:FIXED_WITH]->(rb:Runbook)
RETURN past.id AS incident, past.title AS title, past.symptom AS symptom, s.id AS cause_service,
       c.kind AS cause_kind, c.id AS cause_change, hops, rb.id AS runbook, rb.title AS runbook_title,
       2 + CASE WHEN past.symptom = a.symptom THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS score
ORDER BY score DESC, past.opened_at DESC
LIMIT 5

// purpose: Procedural memory decides: for each recalled incident, the runbook that fixed it names a service and a change kind; suspect in-window changes of that kind on that service, most trusted runbook first.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(o:Service)

queries.name: path_suspects
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Multi-hop suspects: every change in the alert window on a service the alerting service depends on at alert time, nearest first. Starts from the few in-window changes (Change.at range index), not from every dependency path.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(o:Service)
WITH o, a.at AS alert_at
MATCH (c:Change)
WHERE c.at >= alert_at - $window AND c.at <= alert_at
MATCH (c)-[:CHANGED]->(s:Service)
WITH o, s, alert_at, collect(c) AS changes
CALL {
  // Live hops o -> s: the fewest DEPENDS_ON hops (0..6) over edges valid at alert_at, without listing paths.
  // shortestPath ignores validity, so it is only a lower bound: kept when every edge on it is live at alert_at.
  // When it crosses a retired (or not yet live) edge, the traversal with the validity test on each hop (FalkorDB
  // checks a WHERE on the variable-length edge `e` per hop, inside the traversal) settles it, for this pair only.
  WITH o, s, alert_at
  WITH o, s, alert_at, shortestPath((o)-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(s)) AS sp
  WHERE sp IS NOT NULL
  WITH o, s, alert_at, sp,
       all(r IN relationships(sp) WHERE r.valid_from <= alert_at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > alert_at)) AS live
  OPTIONAL MATCH p = (o)-[e:DEPENDS_ON*0..6]->(s)
  WHERE NOT live AND e.valid_from <= alert_at AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to > alert_at)
  WITH live, sp, min(length(p)) AS shortest_live
  WITH CASE WHEN live THEN length(sp) ELSE shortest_live END AS hops
  WHERE hops IS NOT NULL
  RETURN hops
}
UNWIND changes AS c
RETURN c.id AS change, s.id AS service, c.kind AS kind, c.at AS at, c.summary AS summary, hops
ORDER BY hops, at DESC, change

WHERE c.at >= $since AND c.at <= $until

MERGE (e:Evidence {id: $evidence_id})
SET e.verdict = $verdict, e.reason = $reason, e.tag = $tag, e.path = $path, e.at = $at, e.explained = $explained

  WITH o, s, alert_at, sp,
       all(r IN relationships(sp) WHERE r.valid_from <= alert_at AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to > alert_at)) AS live

  WHERE NOT live AND e.valid_from <= alert_at AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR e.valid_to > alert_at)
  WITH live, sp, min(length(p)) AS shortest_live
  WITH CASE WHEN live THEN length(sp) ELSE shortest_live END AS hops
  WHERE hops IS NOT NULL
  RETURN hops

topology_at
queries.cypher:
// purpose: The dependency graph as it was at $at: every DEPENDS_ON edge live at that time. FalkorDB's algorithms walk every edge of a graph and the tenant graph keeps retired and not-yet-live dependencies as history, so this is what gets projected into a scratch graph for an algorithm to run on.

queries.name: project_topology
queries.cypher:
// purpose: Build the point-in-time projection: runs on the scratch graph scratch_<tenant>_topology_<nonce>, which then holds only the edges live at the time in question.
UNWIND $edges AS e
MERGE (a:Service {id: e.caller})
MERGE (b:Service {id: e.callee})
MERGE (a)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(b)
RETURN count(*) AS edges

RETURN node.id AS service, score
ORDER BY score DESC, service

OPTIONAL MATCH (m)-[old:CITES]->()

queries.cypher:
// purpose: Everything the planner looks at, read fresh from the graph before every decision: steps already taken, hypotheses and their status, recalled memory.
MATCH (i:Incident {id: $incident_id})-[:TRIGGERED_BY]->(a:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(o:Service)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:LOGGED]->(st:AgentStep)
WITH i, a, o, collect({tool: st.tool, target: st.target, role: st.role}) AS steps
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:HAS_HYPOTHESIS]->(h:Hypothesis)-[:SUSPECTS]->(c:Change)-[:CHANGED]->(s:Service)
WITH i, a, o, steps,
     collect({id: h.id, change_id: c.id, service: s.id, status: h.status, source: h.source, hops: h.hops,
              at: c.at, explained: h.explained, onset: h.onset, gaps: h.gaps,
              red_before: h.red_before}) AS hypotheses
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[x:RECALLS]->(past:Incident)
WITH i, a, o, steps, hypotheses,
     collect({incident: past.id, score: x.score, cause_service: x.cause_service}) AS recalls
OPTIONAL MATCH (other:Alert)
WHERE other.id <> a.id AND other.at >= a.at - $storm_window AND other.at <= a.at + $storm_window
WITH i, a, o, steps, hypotheses, recalls, count(other) AS storm
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:CORRELATED_WITH]->(:Alert)-[:FIRED_ON]->(cs:Service)
WITH i, a, o, steps, hypotheses, recalls, storm, collect(DISTINCT cs.id) AS correlated
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[su:SHARED_UPSTREAM]->(u:Service)
WITH i, a, o, steps, hypotheses, recalls, storm, correlated, u, su
ORDER BY su.rank
RETURN i.id AS id, i.status AS status, o.id AS service, a.id AS alert, a.at AS at, a.symptom AS symptom,
       steps, hypotheses, recalls, storm, correlated, collect(u.id) AS shared_upstream
